old_caption: The video captures a vibrant nighttime scene in an urban setting, featuring a large open plaza where a spectacular fireworks display is taking place. The fireworks burst in various colors—predominantly red, white, and green—against the dark sky, creating a dazzling spectacle. The ground beneath the fireworks is illuminated by the intense light from the explosions, casting dynamic shadows across the area. A crowd of people gathers around the edges of the plaza, watching the show with excitement and awe. Some individuals are standing close to the edge, while others are further back, all facing towards the center where the fireworks are being set off. The surrounding environment includes modern buildings, one of which has a crane on top, indicating ongoing construction or development. The plaza itself is spacious and paved, with some trees and parked cars visible along the periphery. The overall atmosphere is festive and celebratory, with the fireworks serving as the focal point of the event.

caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display unfolding over a large open paved plaza, viewed from an elevated angle. A multi-story building under construction with a tower crane stands on the left, while a dense crowd of spectators lines the foreground and distant streetlights glow across the background. At the center, bright white flashes erupt and expand into glowing bursts wreathed in smoke. Colored aerial shells burst and fade, mixing red and white starbursts with green bursts and white and gold chrysanthemum-type explosions higher in the sky. Ground-level flares shift among green, red, and sustained orange fountains that shoot upward from several points on the plaza floor. Smoke from the explosions accumulates and drifts upward and toward the right, partially obscuring the sky and the building. The brightest flashes wash out the frame with a pinkish haze, after which the scene recovers its color. The crowd and the building appear stationary, while the visible motion consists of expanding bursts, shifting flares, and rising smoke.

This is a TEMPORALLY CROPPED EXCERPT from a longer video, not a complete event or a loop.
The first view may already be mid-action; the last view need not contain completion. Different
endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.
Do not shorten a rich caption into a terse technical checklist. Avoid annotation phrases such as
'this mid-segment', 'the excerpt', 'the frame', 'these images', 'observed evidence' in the caption.
This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.

draft_caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display unfolding over a large open paved plaza, viewed from an elevated angle. A multi-story building under construction with a tower crane stands on the left, while a dense crowd of spectators lines the foreground and distant streetlights glow across the background. At the center, bright white flashes erupt and expand into glowing bursts wreathed in smoke. Colored aerial shells burst and fade in sequence, with red and white starbursts giving way to green bursts and then to white and gold chrysanthemum-type explosions higher in the sky. Ground-level flares shift among green, red, and sustained orange fountains that shoot upward from several points on the plaza floor. Smoke from the explosions accumulates and drifts upward and to the right, partially obscuring the sky and the building. The brightest flashes wash out the frame with a pinkish haze, after which the scene recovers its color. The crowd and the building remain stationary throughout, while the visible motion consists of expanding bursts and rising smoke.
